newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on Cyprus 91 day bills drops to 5.87 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on Cyprus 91 day bills drops to 5.87 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Tuesday sold 86.45 million ($183.70 million) in 91-day treasury bills with a coupon of 5.87 percent, from 6.048 percent at the last auction on December 27.

A Central Bank statement issued on Tuesday said it had offered up to 100 million in bills. It received bids totalling 110 million pounds but accepted competitive and non competitive bids for 86.45 million. ($=0.47 pounds)
